title: Tidewell brand guidelines 2026
summary: Logo use, color, type and photography rules for web and stores.
body:
Logo use, color, type and photography rules for web and stores.

Logo

  • Use the full wordmark at 120 px wide or larger
  • Keep clear space equal to the height of the T

Color

  • Tide teal #0F4C5C for headers
  • Buoy orange #F2A65A for calls to action only

Type

  • Headings: Instrument Sans Semibold
  • Body: Instrument Sans Regular

title: Corvane discovery report
summary: Findings from integrator interviews and recommendations for the partner portal.
body:
Findings from integrator interviews and recommendations for the partner portal.

What integrators told us

  • They need firmware notes before customers do
  • Spec sheets are emailed around as old versions

Recommendations

  • One library with versioned documents
  • A user group per partner tier
  • Email digest when a document changes
